risk_findings.title: Possible mortgage with no release document uploaded
risk_findings.reason: The documents mention a mortgage, loan or charge, but no release or no-dues reference was found in the uploads. It may exist elsewhere, but it was not seen.
risk_findings.recommended_verification: Ask for the bank's no-dues letter and the registered release deed. Confirm with the bank in writing and check a fresh Encumbrance Certificate before paying.
